Veg Pot Pie.name: Veg Pot Pie
instructions: Boil hard vegetables until soft. Fry onions in margarine. Add all to pan and stir until thick. Add to pie shell and top. Bake at 425°F for 30 minutes.

Vegan Cheese Sauce.name: Vegan Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup cashews, soaked overnight or in hot water to soften
2/3 cup carrot water, water, or coconut milk
instructions: Boil carrots; keep water after. Add all ingredients to blender with 2/3 cup carrot water, water, or coconut milk and blend.

Baked Beans.name: Baked Beans
instructions: In Instant Pot: sauté onion and water. Add garlic and paprika. Add beans, broth, and everything else. Stir; cook 45 minutes and let steam naturally release. Spoon sauce and cook overnight.

Vegan Sloppy Joes.name: Vegan Sloppy Joes
ingredients: 2.5 tbsp brown sugar, plus as needed
instructions: Sauté onion in pan. Add remaining ingredients and tomato sauce to blender and blend. Mix in pan, heat and serve.

Roast Red Pepper & Tomato Soup.name: Roast Red Pepper & Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1–1 1/4 red bell pepper, seeded and sliced
16 oz small tomatoes, sliced in half, or whole canned tomatoes (keep sauce for later)
2 carrots, peeled and chopped in middle
instructions: Add ingredients to baking sheet. Preheat oven to 450°F. Bake 30–40 minutes or until peppers begin to blacken. Let cool enough to handle; peel off any blackened skin.

French Onion Soup.name: French Onion Soup
instructions: Caramelize onions in pan at least 30 minutes. Add garlic for 3 minutes. Add flour for 2–3 minutes. Add broth, Worcestershire sauce, bay leaves, thyme and pepper; simmer 45 minutes, low, uncovered. Ladle into bowls, add bread and cheese, and broil until melted.

Broccoli Cheese Soup (Vegan).name: Broccoli Cheese Soup (Vegan)
instructions: Put starred ingredients in pot and boil/simmer 7–10 minutes until soft; chop vegetables to speed up. Steam broccoli, remove and chop fine. Keep 1 cup of water from steaming and add to main pot. Remove bay leaf; add other ingredients and blend with immersion blender or blender until smooth. Add broccoli.

Plant-Based Mayo.name: Plant-Based Mayo
instructions: Soak cashews in boiling water. Blend until smooth. Start with 2/3–3/4 cup water and add more until desired consistency.

Sweet Potato & Red Lentil Soup.name: Sweet Potato & Red Lentil Soup
ingredients: 2 large sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed
instructions: Toast curry over medium heat about 2 minutes. Add oil and let sizzle. Add onion, garlic and ginger; sauté 5 minutes. Add potato, lentils, broth and coconut milk; simmer about 20 minutes. Purée in Vitamix.
Sweet Potato & Red Lentil Soup.notes: Used 4 medium potatoes and 1 onion. Recipe called for apple, cilantro and lime; did not add.

Instant Pot Recipe – Stew.name: Instant Pot Recipe – Stew
ingredients: 2 lb potatoes, peeled and chopped (3 large)
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic with broth or water for 5 minutes, or clear. Add remainder and cook on high pressure for 8 minutes (takes about 20 minutes to warm).

Balsamic Vinaigrette Dressing.name: Balsamic Vinaigrette Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a 250 mL jar.

Mary's Salad Dressing.name: Mary's Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix dressing. Salad idea: mixed baby greens, beets, carrots, chickpeas, feta cheese, sundried tomatoes, pumpkin/sunflower seeds.

Homemade Pasta.name: Homemade Pasta
instructions: Make flour into bowl. Knead at least 10 minutes and let stand for 30 minutes before making.

Susan's Chocolate Chip Cookies.name: Susan's Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars together. Add eggs, hot water and vanilla; beat until fluffy. Sift together flour, salt and soda, then add. Add chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375°F for 8–10 minutes or until lightly brown.

Next Level Vegan Enchiladas.name: Next Level Vegan Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 cup jarred roasted red pepper, drained/chopped
1 (14 oz/398 mL) can black beans, drained/rinsed
Toppings: Cilantro-Lime Garlic Cashew Sauce, green onion, red pepper flakes, avocado, cilantro
instructions: Prepare enchilada sauce and soak cashews for cashew cream. Grease an 8x12-inch or larger baking dish. Boil or steam sweet potato until fork-tender; drain. Sauté oil, onion and garlic 3–5 minutes. Heat oven to 350°F. Add roasted peppers, sun-dried tomatoes, sweet potato, spinach and black beans; cook 3–5 minutes. Stir in 1/4 cup + 2 tbsp enchilada sauce, lime juice, chili powder, cumin and salt. Spread 3/4 cup sauce in dish. Fill each tortilla with about 3/4 cup filling, roll seam-side down, and cover with remaining sauce. Bake uncovered 20–25 minutes. Prepare cashew sauce and garnish enchiladas before serving.
Next Level Vegan Enchiladas.notes: Prep 1 hr; cook 45 min. Vegan. Source: Oh She Glows.

Enchilada Sauce.name: Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 tbsp vegan butter or extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Melt butter or heat oil over medium. Stir in flour to form a thin paste. Add spices and cook a couple minutes until fragrant. Stir in tomato paste, then broth; whisk smooth. Simmer over low-medium heat, add salt, and cook about 5 minutes or until thickened.
Enchilada Sauce.notes: Prep 5 min; cook 10 min. One batch for enchiladas. Source: Oh She Glows.

Cilantro-Lime Garlic Cashew Sauce.name: Cilantro-Lime Garlic Cashew Sauce
instructions: Cover cashews with boiling water and soak 1 hour, or soak in room-temperature water 8 hours/overnight. Drain and rinse. Blend all ingredients on high until very smooth, adding a splash more water if needed.
Cilantro-Lime Garlic Cashew Sauce.notes: Soak 1–8 hr; prep 5 min. Source: Oh She Glows.

Smoky Quinoa Bean Burgers.name: Smoky Quinoa Bean Burgers
ingredients: 1 (15 oz) can black beans, drained and rinsed
1 (15 oz) can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
Optional toppings: arugula, ketchup, mustard, onion slices, relish, spinach, tomato slices
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment. In a dry frying pan, cook the onion over high heat while stirring, gradually lowering the heat, until browned and softened, about 5–6 minutes. Add the onion, quinoa, both beans, tamari, garlic, cilantro, cumin, cayenne and smoked paprika to a food processor; pulse until finely chopped. Transfer to a bowl and mix in chickpea flour, 1/2 cup panko and black pepper. If too loose to hold together, add more panko. Form about 1/2-cup portions into balls, flatten into patties on the prepared pan, cover and chill at least 20 minutes. Heat oven to 375°F and bake 20–25 minutes, until golden brown. Serve on whole-grain buns with desired toppings.
Smoky Quinoa Bean Burgers.notes: Cookbook recipe; full photo retained in source collection.

The Launcher Quesadilla.name: The Launcher Quesadilla
ingredients: 1/2 cup salsa, plus more for serving
1 (15 oz) can black beans, drained and rinsed
3–4 whole-wheat tortillas, or rice/corn tortillas with no added oil
instructions: Cook the sweet potato until soft: microwave about 8 minutes, bake at 400°F for 45–60 minutes, or peel/cube and steam 8–10 minutes. Mash until smooth. Stir in brown rice, salsa, bell pepper, black beans, onion powder, chili powder and cumin; then fold in spinach. Spread the mixture over a tortilla in a nonstick pan over medium heat and add jalapeño if using. Top with a second tortilla, press gently, and cook about 3 minutes until warmed and lightly browned. Flip and cook about 3 minutes more. Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and hot sauce.

Lemon 'Ricotta' Pancakes with Baked Blue.name: Lemon 'Ricotta' Pancakes with Baked Blueberries & Apple
ingredients: 75 g (2 3/4 oz / 1/2 cup) blueberries, fresh or frozen
1/2 Granny Smith apple (or other tart apple), thinly sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 400°F (200°C) fan-forced and line a tray with baking paper. Bake the blueberries about 20 minutes (or cook them in a pan until softened). For the pancakes, process oats, nutritional yeast, baking powder and salt into a flour. Add coconut yogurt, lemon juice and banana and blend until smooth; stir in lemon zest. Cook about 2 tbsp batter per pancake in a nonstick pan over low heat, flipping once bubbles appear. Serve stacked with baked blueberries, sliced apple, lemon zest and maple syrup.

Mexi Chilli Bowl.name: Mexi Chilli Bowl
ingredients: 280 g (10 oz) canned brown lentils, drained and rinsed
250 g (9 oz) canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat a large saucepan over low heat. Sauté onion, garlic and bell peppers until softened. Add tomatoes, lentils, kidney beans, chili, smoked paprika, cumin and salt. Stir well and simmer about 30 minutes, until cooked through and thickened. Spoon into bowls and serve with tortilla chips, salsa, avocado, cilantro, watercress/sprouts and lime.

Creamy Roast Potato & Dill Salad.name: Creamy Roast Potato & Dill Salad
ingredients: 1 kg (2 lb 3 oz) potatoes, washed and diced
125 mL (4 fl oz / 1/2 cup) plant-based milk
instructions: Heat oven to 400°F (200°C) fan-forced. Spread potatoes on a lined tray and roast about 30 minutes, until crisp; cool. Blend all dressing ingredients except seeded mustard until smooth, then stir in mustard. Combine cooled potatoes with red onion, scallions, dill and coconut bacon. Add dressing and mix well.

Mexi Stuffed Sweet Potatoes.name: Mexi Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 2 kg (4 lb 6 oz) assorted sweet potatoes (approximately)
250 g (9 oz) canned black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F (180°C) fan-forced and line a tray. Lightly score the whole sweet potatoes and bake about 60 minutes, until cooked through; rest about 10 minutes to soften. Cut in half lengthwise. Slice kernels from the corn cob and top the potatoes with corn, bell pepper, avocado, cilantro and black beans. Sprinkle with smoked paprika and serve with cheesy tahini sauce and lime.

Butternut Squash Soup.name: Butternut Squash Soup
ingredients: 3 tbsp clarified butter, ghee or coconut oil
3 cups diced, seeded and peeled butternut squash
4 cups chicken broth (use vegetable broth for plant-based version)
instructions: Melt cooking fat in a large pot over medium heat. Cook onion 2–3 minutes until translucent. Add squash, garlic and ginger and cook about 1 minute, until fragrant. Add broth and bring to a boil; cook until squash is soft, about 10 minutes. Blend until smooth, return to the pot, and cook over medium-high heat 7–10 minutes to thicken. Season with salt and pepper. Optional meal additions from the source include cooked protein and/or greens.
Butternut Squash Soup.notes: Use vegetable broth for plant-based version.

Stuffed Peppers.name: Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 4 red, yellow or orange bell peppers
2 cloves garlic, minced (or 1 tsp garlic powder)
4 kale leaves, stems removed and leaves finely chopped
1 lb ground meat (beef, lamb or bison)
1 cup finely chopped peeled winter squash (butternut, acorn, etc.)
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F and line a deep baking dish. Cut around the tops of the peppers, remove stems/cores/seeds, and bake peppers about 10 minutes to soften; set aside. Heat cooking fat in a large skillet over medium. Cook onion 2–3 minutes, add garlic for about 1 minute, then kale for 1 minute. Add ground meat and cook 2–3 minutes while breaking it up. Stir in tomato paste, cumin, chili powder, salt and pepper; continue until meat is mostly browned, about 7–9 minutes. Add squash and cook 2–3 minutes more. Divide filling among peppers and bake about 10 minutes, until peppers look wrinkled and filling is lightly browned.
Stuffed Peppers.notes: Meat-based; child/adult substitution may be used.

Chipotle Chili.name: Chipotle Chili
ingredients: 1 cup diced red or green bell pepper
1–2 tsp chopped chipotle chiles in adobo sauce
1 (14 oz) can fire-roasted diced tomatoes, undrained
1 (15 oz) can low-sodium black beans, kidney beans or pinto beans, undrained
instructions: Add 1/4 cup water or broth to a large pot over medium-high heat. Add onion, carrots, celery, bell pepper, garlic and sweet potato; cook until almost fork-tender. Stir in chipotle, oregano, chili powder and cumin and cook 1 minute. Add tomatoes with their juices and 2 cups water or broth. Cover and bring to a boil, then reduce heat, uncover and simmer 45 minutes. Stir in beans (drain first, or add with liquid for a thicker chili) and cook on low until heated through. Thin with water/broth if needed. Stir in Worcestershire sauce if using and adjust with extra adobo sauce to taste. Garnish as desired.

Simple Spring Rolls.name: Simple Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup thinly sliced red bell pepper
Thai peanut dressing, coconut dressing, or hoisin sauce thinned with water, for dipping (optional)
instructions: Toss coleslaw mix, bell pepper and cucumber in a bowl. Fill a pan with about 1 cup very warm water. Soak one rice-paper sheet at a time for about 20 seconds, until pliable but not overly soft. Lay flat on a board, place vegetable filling just below centre and drizzle with sriracha if desired. Fold the near edge over the filling, fold the sides inward, then roll tightly like a burrito. Repeat and serve with desired dipping sauce.

Kung Pao Lettuce Wraps.name: Kung Pao Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 (15 oz) can low-sodium chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Whisk sauce ingredients together. Add 1/4 cup water or broth to a skillet over medium-high heat and cook bell pepper and celery until tender. Add sauce and chickpeas and mix well. Reduce heat to low and cook until sauce thickens to a light glaze. Spoon into lettuce cups and garnish with peanuts, cilantro and additional sriracha if desired.

Carrot & Pea Curry.name: Carrot & Pea Curry
ingredients: 2–3 tbsp fresh ginger, minced (about a 1-inch piece)
instructions: Add a thin layer of water or broth to a large pot over medium-high heat. Add garlic and ginger and cook 1–2 minutes until fragrant. Stir in curry powder and smoked paprika. Add coconut milk, tomato paste and 1/2 cup water or broth and bring to a boil. Add carrots, cover and cook over low heat until fork-tender, about 15 minutes. Add peas and simmer uncovered about 5 minutes to cook peas and thicken sauce. Season to taste and garnish with cilantro. Serve over cooked rice or with pita bread.

Southwest Lentil Mac.name: Southwest Lentil Mac
ingredients: 1 cup plain soy milk or almond milk
instructions: Whisk all sauce ingredients except miso in a saucepan. Bring just to a boil over medium heat, reduce to low and cook, stirring often, until slightly thickened; remove from heat and stir in miso. Cook pasta according to package directions, drain and rinse under cool water. Optionally pulse lentils briefly into crumbles. Fold pasta into the sauce, then fold in lentils, salsa, green chiles, avocado and green onions. Garnish with extra green onion if desired.

Not-So-Fat Guacamole.name: Not-So-Fat Guacamole
ingredients: Zest of 1 lime and juice of 2 limes
Pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste
instructions: Cover edamame with water in a saucepan, bring to a boil and cook 5 minutes; drain and rinse cool. Steam broccoli about 8 minutes until very tender, then drain and cool. Purée edamame and broccoli in a food processor until smooth and creamy, adding a little water if needed. Transfer to a bowl and mix in lime zest/juice, tomatoes, onion, cilantro, garlic, salt and cayenne. Chill until ready to serve.
Not-So-Fat Guacamole.notes: Useful with taquitos, nachos and enchiladas.

No-Cheese Sauce.name: No-Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion, peeled and coarsely chopped
1 large red bell pepper, seeded and coarsely chopped
Up to 1/2 cup water, as needed
instructions: Combine onion, red bell pepper, cashews if using, tahini if using, nutritional yeast and salt in a blender in the listed order. Purée until smooth and creamy, adding up to 1/2 cup water as needed for a smooth consistency. If the raw onion is too strong, blanch it briefly in boiling water or sauté it before blending.

Tofu Sour Cream.name: Tofu Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 (12 oz) package extra-firm silken tofu, drained
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and purée until smooth and creamy. Chill until ready to serve.

Mayonnaise.name: Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1 (12 oz) package extra-firm silken tofu, drained
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor and purée until smooth and creamy.

Citrusy Black Bean Taquitos.name: Citrusy Black Bean Taquitos
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion, peeled and diced small
2 tsp cumin seeds, toasted and ground
2 chiles in adobo sauce, minced, or 2 tsp ancho chile powder
4 cups cooked black beans, or two 15 oz cans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Sauté onion in a large saucepan over medium heat for 8–10 minutes, adding 1–2 tbsp water at a time to prevent sticking. Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Add cumin, chiles, orange zest/juice and black beans; season with salt. Purée in a food processor until smooth but still a little chunky. Warm tortillas a few at a time in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, turning frequently, then keep warm in a towel. Spread 3–4 tbsp bean mixture over half of each tortilla and roll up. If desired, warm assembled taquitos in a 200°F oven for 10–15 minutes. Serve with tofu sour cream, guacamole and salsa.

Hearty Nachos.name: Hearty Nachos
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw cashews, soaked in warm water at least 30 minutes and rinsed
1 red bell pepper, roasted and seeded
1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce or Bragg Liquid Aminos
1 (15 oz) can pinto beans, drained and rinsed
1/2 cup finely chopped cilantro, parsley or lettuce
Baked corn tortillas, cut into chips
instructions: For the cheese sauce, blend soaked cashews, tahini, roasted red pepper, nutritional yeast, soy sauce, lemon zest/juice, cayenne and about 1/4 cup water until smooth; set aside. For the bean dip, purée pinto beans, salsa and chili powder, adding water as needed for a smooth consistency; warm over low heat. To assemble, spread bean dip in a serving bowl or baking dish, smooth the surface, add cilantro/parsley/lettuce, then pour cheese sauce over top. Garnish with avocado, salsa, fresh tomatoes and remaining herbs/greens and serve with baked corn chips.

Homemade Pizza.name: Homemade Pizza
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, plus extra to coat bowl
Optional sliced peppers, onions, olives, spinach or other toppings
instructions: Mix the dry ingredients (start with 2 cups flour).
Add warm water and 2 tbsp olive oil; mix. Add more flour as needed until dough forms a ball.
Lightly coat a bowl with olive oil. Roll dough in the bowl to coat; cover with plastic wrap and let rise 30 minutes.
Knead briefly, then roll dough flat for one 10–12-inch pizza.
Spread with homemade pizza sauce and add cheese and your chosen toppings.
Bake at 425°F for 13–15 minutes, until crust is cooked and cheese is melted.
Homemade Pizza.notes: Wednesday family pizza night. Dough recipe transcribed from household recipe card. Makes 1 x 10–12-inch pizza; double dough ingredients if making 2. Homemade pizza sauce is always on hand—exclude it from grocery purchases. The dough is also indexed separately under Breads & Doughs.

Tofu Scramble.name: Tofu Scramble
instructions: Fry onion in water; add pepper. Mix spices in a bowl with enough water to thin. Toss tofu in sauce. Add to pan when vegetables are ready. Fry until slightly moist but not overly dry.

Pancakes.name: Pancakes
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add water and oil; mix until just combined. Cook pancakes on a lightly oiled griddle or pan until browned on both sides.

Banana Bread / Muffins.name: Banana Bread / Muffins
ingredients: Optional: chocolate chips, chopped nuts, dried fruit
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Mix wet and dry ingredients separately, then combine until just mixed. Pour batter into loaf pan and bake 45–50 minutes. For muffins, bake 35–40 minutes.

Sourdough Artisan Bread.name: Sourdough Artisan Bread
instructions: Mix starter, water and salt; add flour and mix well. Rest 1 hour. Perform 4 stretch-and-folds, 30 minutes apart. Cover and bulk ferment 4–6 hours at room temperature. Flatten and preshape. Place dough in a floured banneton for final proof overnight or 2–3 hours at room temperature. Preheat Dutch oven with lid inside at 500°F for 30 minutes. Transfer loaf on parchment to heated Dutch oven. Reduce to 460°F and bake covered 20 minutes. Remove lid, reduce to 450°F and bake uncovered 20 minutes.

Sourdough Starter Ratios.name: Sourdough Starter Ratios
ingredients: 1:1:1 — 50 g starter, 50 g water, 50 g flour
1:4:4 — 30 g starter, 120 g water, 120 g flour
1:5:5 — 10 g starter, 50 g water, 50 g flour
instructions: 1:1:1 is noted for later same-day use. 1:4:4 is noted for the next day, about 12 hours. 1:5:5 is noted as ideal for an overnight feed, peaking in about 24 hours.

Vegan Tea Biscuits.name: Vegan Tea Biscuits
instructions: Mix ingredients lightly and finish by hand. Roll into a ball, flatten to about 1 inch thick and cut out biscuits. Bake at 400°F for 12–15 minutes.

Pizza Dough.name: Pizza Dough
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, plus additional for bowl
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add warm water and olive oil; mix. Add more flour as needed until a ball forms. Coat bowl with olive oil and roll dough in bowl until coated. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise 30 minutes. Knead and roll flat. Bake 13–15 minutes at 425°F.
Pizza Dough.notes: Household Wednesday pizza dough; also included in the Homemade Pizza entry with sauce and toppings. No added salt.

Pie Crust – Top & Bottom.name: Pie Crust – Top & Bottom
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Cut butter into flour. Add ice water and mix into a ball. Knead dough, split into two and roll for pan. Bake at 350°F for 45–50 minutes. Card notes crust will shrink; add beans for weight or freeze 35 minutes first.

Dill Pickles.name: Dill Pickles
instructions: Bring brine to a boil. Stuff jars with garlic, dill and cucumbers; add alum. Pour boiling brine over and close lids. Place jars in boiling-water bath for 15 minutes. Place on towel for 24 hours to seal.

Simple Bread.name: Simple Bread
ingredients: 2 tbsp canola oil, plus more to coat bread for rise
instructions: In a large bowl combine yeast with 1/2 tsp sugar and let stand until yeast bubbles, about 10 minutes. Separately mix 3 cups flour with remaining sugar. Add oil to water/yeast mixture. Gradually add flour mixture, continuing to add flour and mix until dough forms. Knead until smooth, 8–10 minutes. Let rise in warmth 1 1/2–2 hours. Divide in half and place in 2 bread pans. Let rise another 1–1 1/2 hours. Bake at 375°F until brown, 30–35 minutes.

Oatmeal Breakfast Muffins.name: Oatmeal Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Combine wet ingredients and dry ingredients separately, then fold together. Bake large muffins about 45 minutes or standard muffins about 35 minutes.

Tortilla Shells.name: Tortilla Shells
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups flour (1.5 cups whole wheat + 1 cup regular noted)
1/4 cup vegetable oil, butter or margarine
instructions: Mix ingredients and knead into a smooth ball. Divide into 8 portions; cover and let rise/rest 10–30 minutes. Roll flat and fry in a pan over medium heat about 30 seconds per side, until lightly browned.

Basic Pie Crust.name: Basic Pie Crust
instructions: Cut butter or shortening into flour. Add water, mix and knead. Refrigerate until cold if desired, then roll out.

Chocolate Chip Drop Cookies.name: Chocolate Chip Drop Cookies
instructions: Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375°F for 8–10 minutes or until lightly brown.
Chocolate Chip Drop Cookies.notes: Page 45 appears to be the continuation/end of a recipe whose first page was not included; only visible portion transcribed.

Vanilla Icing.name: Vanilla Icing
instructions: Mix until icing consistency.

Cupcakes.name: Cupcakes
instructions: Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes.

Chocolate Icing.name: Chocolate Icing
instructions: Beat butter until fluffy. Add icing sugar slowly (may not need full cup). Add cocoa powder.

Brownies – Helen.name: Brownies – Helen
instructions: Blend butter and sugars well. Add eggs one at a time, beating between additions. Stir in flour, baking powder and vanilla. Pour into prepared 9 x 13 pan; add chocolate chips. Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes or until batter is set.

Andrews Family Icing.name: Andrews Family Icing
ingredients: can replace corn syrup with caramel for caramel icing
instructions: Combine ingredients except flavouring in double boiler; beat until super peaky/dissolved. Place over double boiler and beat until it holds shape (4–7 min), scraping sides/bottom. Remove from heat; add flavouring and continue beating until icing cools.

Hershey's Chocolate Chip Cookies.name: Hershey's Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix butter and sugars, then add flour. Bake 8–10 minutes at 375°F. Add chocolate chips last.

Rice Crispy Squares.name: Rice Crispy Squares
instructions: Melt butter. Add marshmallows and stir until melted. Add vanilla. Press into greased 13 x 9-inch pan and chill until firm.

Christmas Crack.name: Christmas Crack
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line tray with foil and place crackers. Melt butter with brown sugar; bring to a boil without stirring. Pour over crackers and bake about 10 minutes. Cover with chocolate and spread evenly.

Butterscotch Confetti Squares.name: Butterscotch Confetti Squares
instructions: Melt peanut butter and butter on low; add butterscotch chips and melt. Put marshmallows in large bowl, pour mixture over and fold together. Press into greased 8 x 8 pan; refrigerate until firm.

Chocolate Batter Pudding – Eleanor.name: Chocolate Batter Pudding – Eleanor
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Cut in shortening. Whisk milk and egg; stir into dry ingredients.
Chocolate Batter Pudding – Eleanor.notes: Card continues with topping ingredients; baking directions not visible on page.

Chocolate Chip Cookies.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Stir brown butter. Bake at 375°F for 12 minutes. Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes; take off foil and cook another 20 minutes. Remove from oven and let sit 5 minutes.
Chocolate Chip Cookies.notes: Directions on reverse appear to include notes from another dish; transcribed as written.

Black Bean + Sweet Potato Casserole.name: Black Bean + Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Combine all ingredients in a 9 x 13 pan.

Tomato Casserole – Susan.name: Tomato Casserole – Susan
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13. Bake at 350°F for 1–1.5 hours.
Tomato Casserole – Susan.notes: Reverse: cook macaroni; blend together soup + margarine + mustard; stir blend plus all remaining ingredients; add combo to topping; pour over top; bake uncovered at 350°F for 45–50 min. This may belong to another recipe.

Pasta with Homemade Red Sauce.name: Pasta with Homemade Red Sauce
ingredients: optional frozen spinach, peas or white beans
optional shredded cheese or nutritional yeast.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Warm homemade red sauce, adding spinach, peas or drained white beans if desired. Toss together; top with optional cheese or nutritional yeast.
Pasta with Homemade Red Sauce.notes: Cheffy Created. Emergency Easy. Sauce is already stocked and should not be added to the shopping list; vegetables and beans are optional.

Creamy White Bean & Spinach Pasta.name: Creamy White Bean & Spinach Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta, reserving some pasta water. Sauté garlic in oil. Add beans, plant milk and nutritional yeast; simmer briefly. Stir in spinach to wilt. Add pasta and lemon juice, loosening with pasta water as needed.
Creamy White Bean & Spinach Pasta.notes: Cheffy Created. Uses common pantry staples and spinach.

Chickpea Coconut Curry.name: Chickpea Coconut Curry
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic and ginger in oil. Add curry powder and cook 1 minute. Stir in chickpeas, coconut milk and tomatoes; simmer 15–20 minutes. Add spinach until wilted. Serve over rice.

Lentil Shepherd's Pie.name: Lentil Shepherd's Pie
ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil or vegan butter
instructions: Boil potatoes and mash with oil/butter and plant milk. Sauté onion, carrot, celery and garlic. Add lentils, peas, tomato paste, broth and thyme; simmer until thick. Transfer to casserole dish, top with mashed potatoes and bake at 400°F for about 25 minutes.
Lentil Shepherd's Pie.notes: Cheffy Created. Good Sunday dinner and leftovers.

Creamy Broccoli Pasta.name: Creamy Broccoli Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta and broccoli until tender. Blend plant milk, cashews, nutritional yeast, garlic and lemon until smooth. Warm sauce in pot, season, and toss with pasta and broccoli.
Creamy Broccoli Pasta.notes: Cheffy Created. Family-friendly; overlaps with broccoli soup ingredients.

Vegetable Fried Rice with Tofu.name: Vegetable Fried Rice with Tofu
instructions: Crumble or cube tofu and brown in a large pan. Add onion, carrots, peas and garlic; cook until tender. Add cold rice and tamari; stir-fry until hot and lightly browned. Garnish with green onion if desired.
Vegetable Fried Rice with Tofu.notes: Cheffy Created. Use-up-the-fridge meal; best with leftover rice.

Chickpea Salad Sandwiches.name: Chickpea Salad Sandwiches
instructions: Mash chickpeas, leaving some texture. Mix with mayo, mustard, celery, onion, lemon, salt and pepper. Serve on bread or in wraps.
Chickpea Salad Sandwiches.notes: Cheffy Created. Lunch option; uses existing mayo recipe.

White Bean Tomato Soup.name: White Bean Tomato Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic. Add beans, tomatoes, broth and herbs. Simmer 20 minutes. Blend a portion if a creamier texture is desired, then stir in spinach until wilted.
White Bean Tomato Soup.notes: Cheffy Created. Pantry-friendly; pairs with homemade bread or biscuits.

Baked Pasta with Red Sauce & Spinach.name: Baked Pasta with Red Sauce & Spinach
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups shredded cheese or vegan cheese
instructions: Cook pasta just shy of done. Combine with sauce, spinach and optional beans. Transfer to baking dish, top with cheese and bake at 375°F for 20–25 minutes until hot and bubbling.
Baked Pasta with Red Sauce & Spinach.notes: Cheffy Created. Uses always-on-hand homemade red sauce.

Loaded Baked Potatoes.name: Loaded Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 1 cup vegan cheese sauce or shredded cheese
instructions: Bake potatoes at 425°F until tender. Steam broccoli and warm beans. Split potatoes and top with broccoli, beans and cheese sauce/cheese.
Loaded Baked Potatoes.notes: Cheffy Created. Easy customizable dinner. Include broccoli and beans for an effortless vegetable/protein boost; overlaps with Baked Potato Night.

Sheet-Pan Chickpeas, Potatoes & Vegetabl.name: Sheet-Pan Chickpeas, Potatoes & Vegetables
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss all ingredients except dressing on a sheet pan. Roast 30–40 minutes, stirring once, until potatoes are tender and vegetables browned. Serve with optional tahini dressing.
Sheet-Pan Chickpeas, Potatoes & Vegetabl.notes: Cheffy Created. Flexible use-up meal with common produce.

Grilled Cheese & Soup.name: Grilled Cheese & Soup
instructions: Make grilled cheese sandwiches in a skillet until crisp and melted. Serve with leftover or freshly prepared soup.

Beans, Rice & Avocado Bowls.name: Beans, Rice & Avocado Bowls
ingredients: optional corn, cilantro, lime and cheese/no-cheese sauce
instructions: Warm rice and beans. Divide among bowls and top with avocado, salsa and any optional toppings on hand.
Beans, Rice & Avocado Bowls.notes: Cheffy Created. Emergency/simple meal; strong ingredient overlap.

Breakfast-for-Dinner.name: Breakfast-for-Dinner
ingredients: Choose pancakes or tofu scramble from collection
instructions: Prepare one breakfast recipe from the collection and serve with toast/English muffins and fruit. Add potatoes if a larger dinner is needed.

Baked Potato Night.name: Baked Potato Night
ingredients: choice of leftover chili, beans, broccoli, cheese/no-cheese sauce, green onion or other leftovers
instructions: Bake potatoes until tender. Set out available toppings and let each person build their own potato.
Baked Potato Night.notes: Cheffy Created. Designed to use leftovers and reduce waste.

Massaged Kale Salad.name: Massaged Kale Salad
instructions: Remove kale leaves from stems and tear/chop into bite-size pieces. Add olive oil, lemon juice, salt and optional garlic powder. Massage about 1 minute until wilted and soft. Add nutritional yeast and massage briefly to combine.
Massaged Kale Salad.notes: Weekly salad-prep option. Source: Simply Quinoa.

Lentil Quinoa Salad.name: Lentil Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, cooked according to package directions
1/2 cup canned lentils, drained and rinsed
instructions: Cook quinoa and allow to cool. Combine quinoa, lentils, parsley, mint, pecans/walnuts, cucumber and tomatoes. Add lemon juice, seasonings and balsamic glaze; toss. Refrigerate up to 4 days.
Lentil Quinoa Salad.notes: Weekly salad-prep option. Mint added as confirmed. Source: PlantYou.

Eat to Live Salad with Lemon Basil Vinai.name: Eat to Live Salad with Lemon Basil Vinaigrette
ingredients: Dressing: 1/4 cup lemon basil vinegar OR 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice + 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1/2 cup no-salt-added cooked/canned beans (black, red, chickpeas, lentils or edamame)
optional carrots, bell peppers, cucumbers, other raw vegetables or water-sauteed mushrooms
instructions: Blend dressing ingredients in a high-powered blender until smooth. Combine salad ingredients and toss with desired amount of dressing.
Eat to Live Salad with Lemon Basil Vinai.notes: Weekly salad-prep option. For family weekly prep, scale salad portion as needed; dressing makes 4 servings. Source: Eat to Live recipe image supplied by user.

Vegan Broccoli Cheddar Orzo.name: Vegan Broccoli Cheddar Orzo
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups coconut milk, soy cream, or cashew cream
instructions: Combine orzo, broccoli and carrots in a covered casserole. Stir in broth, cream, nutritional yeast and seasonings. Bake at 375°F about 30 minutes; top with vegan cheddar and bake uncovered 5–10 minutes more.
Vegan Broccoli Cheddar Orzo.notes: Approved. Low active cook / dump-and-bake. No added salt. Source: https://plantyou.com/vegan-broccoli-cheddar-orzo/

Chickpea / Tuna Melts.name: Chickpea / Tuna Melts
instructions: Mash chickpeas and mix with mayo, Dijon, onion and pickles. Prepare husband's tuna separately. Assemble sandwiches with cheese and cook in skillet until bread is toasted and cheese melts.
Chickpea / Tuna Melts.notes: Approved Emergency Easy. Split filling: chickpea for wife, real tuna for husband. Source: https://minimalistbaker.com/easy-vegan-tuna-melt/

Vegan Pastitsio with Lentils.name: Vegan Pastitsio with Lentils
ingredients: 1 x 28 oz can no-salt diced tomatoes
instructions: Steam potatoes. Blend most potatoes with part of the milk, nutritional yeast, vinegar and garlic for sauce. Cook onion/garlic with lentils, tomatoes, lemon and spices. Undercook pasta slightly; combine with remaining milk/nutritional yeast/rice flour and potato sauce. Layer pasta and lentils and bake at 375°F until hot and lightly golden.
Vegan Pastitsio with Lentils.notes: Approved Sunday / higher effort. No added salt. Source: https://www.forksoverknives.com/recipes/vegan-pasta-noodles/vegan-pastitsio-with-lentils-greek-lasagna/

Red Lentil Curry.name: Red Lentil Curry
ingredients: 1 tbsp fresh turmeric or 1 tsp ground
1/2 tsp Indian red chili powder (or mild chili powder)
instructions: Sauté aromatics briefly, bloom spices, then add lentils, broth and tomatoes. Simmer until lentils soften. Stir in coconut milk and almond butter; finish with lemon and cilantro.
Red Lentil Curry.notes: Approved. One-pot. No added salt; keep spice mild for family. Source: https://rainbowplantlife.com/vegan-red-lentil-curry/

15-Minute Vegan Alfredo Pasta.name: 15-Minute Vegan Alfredo Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta, garlic, broth, soy milk, nutritional yeast and pepper together in a large pan, stirring as pasta softens and sauce thickens. Add extra liquid if needed. Finish with lemon and parsley; stir in frozen vegetables near the end.
15-Minute Vegan Alfredo Pasta.notes: Approved Emergency Easy. Very low active cook. No added salt. Source: https://plantyou.com/easy-vegan-alfredo-pasta/

Tofu / Chicken Fried Rice.name: Tofu / Chicken Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 x 12 oz firm tofu (wife/child portion as desired)
instructions: Cook rice. Marinate tofu with vinegar, garlic, ginger, turmeric and water; brown and chop. Cook husband's chicken separately. Combine rice, scallions and vegetables, then split/add tofu and chicken near the end.
Tofu / Chicken Fried Rice.notes: Approved split-protein meal. No added salt. Source: https://www.forksoverknives.com/recipes/amazing-grains/oil-free-tofu-fried-rice/

Creamy Thai Red Curry Noodles.name: Creamy Thai Red Curry Noodles
instructions: Simmer noodles, vegetables, broth, coconut milk, curry paste, soy sauce, garlic, ginger and maple together until noodles and vegetables are tender. Keep proteins separate and add tofu to wife's portion and chicken to husband's portion near the end. Finish with lime and cilantro.
Creamy Thai Red Curry Noodles.notes: Approved Emergency Easy. Very low active cook; split-protein meal. Source: https://plantyou.com/creamy-thai-red-curry-noodles/

French Onion Pasta.name: French Onion Pasta
ingredients: 3 tbsp white wine or lemon juice
instructions: Roast sliced onions with wine/lemon, paprika, thyme, coconut milk and whole garlic head at 400°F until deeply caramelized, stirring once. Cook pasta separately. Squeeze roasted garlic into onions, toss with pasta and a little pasta water, and finish with parsley/parmesan if using.
French Onion Pasta.notes: Approved. Low active cook but long total time; suited to Sunday. Source: https://plantyou.com/french-onion-pasta/

No-Salt No-Knead Bread.name: No-Salt No-Knead Bread
instructions: Mix flour, yeast and water into a sticky dough. Cover 18–24 hours. Shape on a floured surface and rise about 2 hours. Preheat a covered Dutch oven at 450°F. Bake covered about 30 minutes, then uncovered 15–20 minutes until browned.
No-Salt No-Knead Bread.notes: Household Tested/Favourite. User made successfully with no salt. Source: https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/214751/no-knead-artisan-style-bread/

Cereal + Milk.name: Cereal + Milk
instructions: Serve cereal with milk and fruit if using.

Oatmeal + Fruit.name: Oatmeal + Fruit
instructions: Cook oatmeal according to package directions and top with fruit.

Toast + Peanut Butter / Jam.name: Toast + Peanut Butter / Jam
instructions: Toast bread and add preferred spread.

Bagel + Cream Cheese.name: Bagel + Cream Cheese
ingredients: Cream cheese or plant-based cream cheese
instructions: Toast bagel if desired and add cream cheese.

English Muffin + Spread.name: English Muffin + Spread
ingredients: Peanut butter, jam or cream cheese
instructions: Toast and add preferred spread.

Simple Lunch / Leftovers.name: Simple Lunch / Leftovers
ingredients: Available leftovers or simple household staples
instructions: Use remaining prepared food first to reduce waste.

Leftovers.name: Leftovers
ingredients: Remaining prepared food from the week
instructions: Reheat and serve; prioritize perishables that need using.

Black Bean & Rice Wraps.name: Black Bean & Rice Wraps
instructions: Warm rice and black beans. Sauté or briefly soften the pepper and onion, if preferred. Fill wraps with rice, beans, cheese, vegetables, salsa and sour cream; fold and serve. Keep spicy salsa separate for children.
Black Bean & Rice Wraps.notes: Cheffy Created. Emergency Easy; 10–15 minutes with prepared rice. Overlaps with quesadillas and snack vegetables.

Loaded Veggie Kaiser Sandwiches.name: Loaded Veggie Kaiser Sandwiches
instructions: Slice buns. Spread hummus on each bun; layer lettuce, cheese, cucumber, pepper, onion, pickles and olives. Toast buns first if desired. Serve remaining cut vegetables on the side.
Loaded Veggie Kaiser Sandwiches.notes: Cheffy Created. Emergency Easy; no-cook. Use the same cucumber and pepper purchased for vegetable snacks.

Gnocchi with Homemade Red Sauce.name: Gnocchi with Homemade Red Sauce
ingredients: 1 package shelf-stable or refrigerated gnocchi (about 500–750 g, according to appetite)
optional spinach, peas, shredded cheese or nutritional yeast.
instructions: Cook gnocchi according to package directions and drain. Warm homemade red sauce; stir in a handful of spinach or frozen peas if desired. Toss gnocchi with sauce and top as preferred.
Gnocchi with Homemade Red Sauce.notes: Cheffy Created. Emergency Easy; 10–15 minutes. Homemade red sauce is Always On Hand; do not add it to grocery purchases.

Black Bean & Cheese Quesadillas.name: Black Bean & Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: salsa and sour cream for serving.
instructions: Spread beans, shredded cheese, pepper and onion on half of each wrap. Fold and cook in a dry skillet over medium heat until golden and cheese melts, flipping once. Cut into wedges; serve with salsa and sour cream.
Black Bean & Cheese Quesadillas.notes: Cheffy Created. Emergency Easy; 10–15 minutes. Shares groceries with Black Bean & Rice Wraps.
